scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,app "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:4000/api/health && electron ."
scripts.start: npm run build:client && concurrently -k -n api,app "node server/src/index.js" "wait-on http://localhost:4000/api/health && MUSEUMX_PROD=1 electron ."
